convention: C_published = u^2 inverse(U^T U), with only U diagonal multiplied by u/quoted_sigma; u=sqrt(Q/nu), nu=Ntr-5, Q from inverse Wilson-Hilferty transform of F2. Equivalently B=U/u; C_published=solve(B,I) solve(B,I)^T. No max(u,1) catalogue-combination policy.
rounding: UW and formal errors are printed to 0.01 in source units; F2 to 0.01. Report diagonal differences; do not force exact agreement or invent a pass threshold.
scope: Standard five-parameter source covariance qualification only. Nonstandard solutions, propagation, physical uncertainty and epoch-scale qualification not admitted.
